needsBespoke.why: Plasma's interaction across abilities needs bespoke ordering logic: Void Seeker applies 2-3 stacks 'as if applied successively' (each one dealing its own Caustic Wounds damage based on the stack count at that moment), and if it crosses the 5-stack detonation threshold mid-application, remaining stacks are reapplied afterward, with a specific damage-ordering rule (initial Caustic Wounds, then detonation, then Void Seeker's own bolt damage, then attack on-hit last if it's the trigger). No single closed-list primitive captures this multi-step successive-stack-application-with-interleaved-detonation behavior; it must be scripted as a small state machine around the target-stacks/execute-or-threshold primitives.

proposal: Assume Living Weapon evolutions are already active on all three basic abilities (sufficient items to meet AD/AP/AS thresholds), since evolutions strictly increase damage/utility and the fight is a fixed-loadout item build test.
Open with Void Seeker (W) to apply 2-3 Plasma stacks and deal its magic damage instance, using its low cast time before entering attack range.
Auto-attack continuously to build/refresh Plasma stacks (1 per hit) and trigger Caustic Wounds damage on each application, working toward and through the 5th-stack detonation repeatedly.
Cast Icathian Rain (Q) on cooldown for its 6 (or 12 evolved) missile hits of physical damage.

Cast Supercharge (E) as soon as available and off-cooldown-permitting, timing it so its post-charge attack-speed buff overlaps with the following auto-attack window, since each attack during that window also shaves 0.5s off Supercharge's own cooldown to bring it back sooner.
Recast Void Seeker (W) on cooldown for repeated magic damage plus Plasma reapplication/detonation.

Ignore Killer Instinct (R) in the damage fight except to leverage its attack-reset if it usefully realigns the next auto-attack, since its shield/dash are pure survivability with no target requirement satisfied on a stationary dummy that lacks Plasma persistence issues (dummy is 'affected by Plasma' via attacks, so R could be cast for the attack reset alone).

In the survival fight (Kai'Sa as the tank), only R's shield (and passively its cooldown-based reapplication) contributes to survivability; ignore Q/W/E for damage-taken purposes and use R defensively on cooldown to soak the enemy's rotation.
